title: Clash of Clans Intro
blurb: Supercell opened a billion village-checking sessions with a war horn. Mobile gaming has never produced three more nostalgic seconds. Clash of Clans launched in 2012 and colonised an entire era of school breaks and commutes. Hearing the fanfare teleports a generation straight back to raid planning, shield timers and the specific anguish of having all five builders busy. Play it before any strategic undertaking: an actual game, a difficult email, or the negotiation over how a restaurant bill is going to be divided.
origin: The startup fanfare from Clash of Clans (Supercell).
